newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 23.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's edition of Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - MCA Inc of Seagram Co Ltd is close to finalizing an estimated $50 million to $75 million deal with Gannett Co Inc to purchase Multimedia Entertainment.

NEW YORK - Scott Sassa, the former president of Turner Entertainment Group of Turner Broadcasting System Inc and Time Warner Inc, is expected to be named CEO at Marvel Entertainment Group Inc on Thursday.
